signal: C[d-1]>C[d-29]; strictly completed UTC daily closes; decision 00:00:05; execute 01:00 open

ranks.R2: R1/(sample std(ddof=1) of 28 log daily returns * sqrt(28))
ranks.R3: R1 - BTC_R1; same ordering as R1, not independent evidence

ties: lexicographic symbol order; undefined scores last, undefined allocations left cash; <=2 eligible no ranking needed
weights: three eligible: top two .5 each; two: 1/3 each; one: 1/3; zero: cash; baseline 1/3 each eligible
accounting: Primary continuous 2024-2025, initial cash only; no annual reset; year returns chained from prior year-end NAV. External original T01 independent initial 1/3 sleeves. Additional annual C0 trials solely reconcile prior corrected benchmark.
target: pre-trade NAV * weight / (price*(1+fee+slip)); sells first, buys pro-rata cash budget; never borrow
execution: buy quote spend rounded down quote step; modeled filled gross base rounded down base step, refund fractional remainder; buy fee deducted in acquired base; sell gross base rounded down base step, fee in received quote; min notional checks actual adverse execution value; skip retains true balances
terminal: 2025-12-31 23:00 open, apply same modeled fees and minimum to liquidation; report cash actually realizable separately from residual dust MTM; no 2026 prices
risk: hourly open marked NAV for MDD; UTC daily close NAV for returns/Sharpe sqrt365 ddof1 risk-free0; Calmar annualized 731-day return/abs(MDD); report annual, monthly, hourly average exposure and cash fraction

random.scope: C5 BASE/STRESS all four capitals; same eligible pool and exposure, independently choose top2 only when3 eligible, identical trading engine; percentile and paired reference

bootstrap.method: paired circular calendar block bootstrap of daily rank-minus-common-baseline net returns; mean difference, CI and one-sided centered-null p; Holm correction across all3 including duplicate R3
bootstrap.primary: C5 BASE/STRESS; all capitals; no post-selection significance

leave_one_out: C5 BASE/STRESS all capitals; excluded sleeve retained cash, original 1/3 per remaining eligible; no concentration to replace excluded coin

gates.economic: report positive modeled annual and full-period net, not live proof
gates.ranking: compelling only if both years BASE/STRESS positive incremental returns, Holm p<.05 for both7/30 blocks and drawdown increase<=5 percentage points; otherwise NO-GO or PROMISING/UNCONFIRMED with all failures shown
gates.execution: UNKNOWN historical filters prevents historical execution claims and original 2026 OOS access

stage_c: plan only if promising, no universe downloads
stage_d: bounded free metadata-only historical search, no OOS prices unless original immutable preflight passes; otherwise forward-paper plan only
